overview_description.description:
Cedalio provides the building blocks for application builders that want to get the benefits of decentralized technology. At Cedalio you can use decentralized DBs to build censorship-resistant applications with user-centric data control and the ability to tokenize specific data fields, placing them directly on the chain for transparent and immutable record-keeping.

It was founded in 2022 and is located in San Francisco, California.

about_short_description.short_description: Cedalio provides the building blocks for application builders that want to get the benefits of decentralized technology.

product.name: AI-Powered Energy Data Platform
product.description: A platform that automates extraction, standardization, and analysis of utility bill data to provide insights on energy, water, gas consumption, and emissions across multiple sites.

product.name: Utility Bill Upload and Processing
product.description: A service that allows users to upload utility bills via email, drag-and-drop PDFs, or integrations with cloud storage and ERPs for automated data extraction.

product.name: Energy Data Standardization and Validation
product.description: Automated extraction and standardization of energy data from utility bills with error checking to ensure data accuracy and consistency.

product.name: Anomaly Detection and Usage Monitoring
product.description: A feature that visualizes energy consumption trends and detects anomalies or unusual usage patterns with real-time alerts.

product.name: Reporting and Compliance Tools
product.description: Tools to export clean, customizable reports for internal teams and regulatory compliance, supporting multiple formats and tailored to specific standards.
